# 1.2.78 - the first drag into a new room counts

A fix released on its own (stage E84), ahead of the next stage of the plan.
On 1.2.77 at a Foundry v14 table, the GM's Monokuma dragged into another
room kept the old room on the room tile (its name, description and
picture), played no arrival in the fog and was not announced as a move
into the new room until a second drag inside it. A player's character
may have missed its crossing the same way; that was not seen at the
table. The module now reads the token's room once more when it comes to
rest, so the first drag counts. In the plan, the secret passages stage
(E79) moves to 1.2.79; in `tools/stages.json` the planned stages after
this one move up one number, all but the last (1.3.0).

## At the table

- **A drag into another room** shows the new room on the room tile, plays
  the fog's arrival and, for a player's character, is charged once, on
  the first drag. The fog follows about a third of a second after the
  token stops; the tile and the charge the same, or a second and a half
  later when the hook read only a step of the drag. However long Foundry
  reports the token as moving, the second reading starts at most about
  five seconds after the hook's own reading ends (the fog's, at most
  about three and a half seconds after the update). The tile and the
  charge are
  measured in the headless harness (scenario 74, phase L); the timings
  and the fog's arrival, which needs a canvas, are read in the code
  only. At a table all of it is LIVE-E78-14.
- **A drag that the hook already read where it ended** works as before:
  the second reading finds the room already recorded and does nothing.
  The scenarios' drags are such drags, and they stay green (scenarios
  66 and 40, the suite; every scenario check by check against the run
  on 1.2.77's tree, in Checked).
- **With the module's debug on**, the console of the browser that read a
  move again says "read again at rest", with the room it had recorded and
  the room the token stands in. It also says so when a step of the drag
  was still noted, whatever the room. At a table that line tells which
  drags needed the second reading.

## Changed

- **`scripts/movement.mjs`**: a character's move is judged once more where
  the token stands, after its movement animation and any pending movement
  are over (at most 3 s, then 250 ms). It runs only for a character whose
  room this browser has recorded, when no newer move of that token arrived
  meanwhile, no put-back is on its way, no route of it is still being
  settled, and the room differs from the one recorded or a pending step of
  the drag is still noted (then after a further 1.5 s of quiet). The move
  is then judged and announced again (`drpgRouteSettled`, which the room
  tile repaints on), naming the room the token stands in; a crossing is
  charged once.
- **`scripts/fog.mjs`**: the fog's local repaint and the primary GM's
  discovery ledger also run once more at rest; both change nothing when
  the room is the one already read.
- **Scenario 74** has a new phase, L, that stands in two readings that
  could explain the report, on the browser that judges the move, by
  holding the token's position and movement state on its document: the
  GM's Monokuma from the Hall to the Cafeteria and a player's character
  into a new room with the hook reading the drag's start, and the same
  character back by a last update that still has a step pending.
- **The audit's live checks** gain item 236 (LIVE-E78-14).
- **`tools/stages.json`** carries E84 as 1.2.78 and moves every later
  planned stage but 1.3.0 one number on.
- **The manifest's compatibility and relationships are unchanged**:
  Daggerheart `minimum` and `verified` stay 2.6.5, Foundry `verified`
  stays 14.365.

## Known gaps

- Which of the two readings happened at the owner's table is not
  measured. The fix covers both, but neither was seen on a real Foundry v14
  (LIVE-E78-14).
- A player's character was not seen to miss a crossing at the table. In
  the harness it goes through the same second reading as the GM's
  Monokuma, but is judged as a student: its crossing is charged, the
  Monokuma's never is.
- When the hook read the drag's start, the move is announced twice: first
  for the room the token left, then at rest for the room it stands in.
  Only the room tile listens, and it draws the room it is told, so the
  tile ends on the right room (read in the code and in phase L).
- The fog's second reading is not measured: the harness draws no canvas,
  so scenario 74 reads the tile, the charge and the announcement only.
- When Foundry reports a token as moving for longer than three seconds,
  the second reading does not wait longer: it reads the token where it is
  then (read in the code).

- The full test run (`npm test`) on the fix's tree, commit 7ac773b:
  green, in 78 min 44 s (79 min 38 s with the wait for the machine's
  locks). It is compared with the full run on 1.2.77's tree before its
  release commit (3ad0ca0). The suite (1338 passed, 0 failed, 23
  skipped) is test by test the same, in the same order and with the same
  reasons. The 26 scenarios are green, each with the same checks but
  scenario 74, which gains phase L's three (41 of 41, where it had 38 of
  38). Scenarios 72 and 75 keep the expected reds they had (three and
  one).
- Scenario 74 alone, on the fix's tree: 41 of 41 checks in 81.9 s. With
  the fix taken out, phase L's three checks fail: L1 and L2 with the tile
  on the old room, L2 and L3 with no action charged. L3 ran after L2 had
  failed, so the pending-step reading was not shown failing on its own.
  Scenarios 66 (62 of 62) and 40 (86 of 86) green on the same tree.
  The suite run from the harness (scenario 01) on the same tree: 1338
  passed, 0 failed, 23 skipped, 20 of 20 checks. The lint, the checks
  (13 parts) and the gate's self-test (36 of 36) green.
- The ledger row: on copies with module.json at 1.2.78, `ship E84` is
  refused on 1.2.77's ledger and `check` fails; on this one `ship E84`
  writes 1.2.78 and `check` passes.
- The ledger commit 87b963e changes `tools/stages.json` and a comment in
  `tools/stages.mjs` only; the full run was not repeated on it, and the
  release commit's checks run on top of it.
- The fix is commit 7ac773b and the ledger row 87b963e. Neither commit
  had a review of its code; these notes and the verify ledger were read
  against the code and the logs three times.
- Not checked in a real Foundry yet: the audit's live check, section 9.2,
